decisions.reason: As the flagship of the firm's organic expansion, close to its core competencies and launched into a growing market, the platter line meets aspirations well enough that management has no shortfall prompting problemistic search.

The organic poultry snack fits the strategic organic push and has its own web page, and with industry growth and hiring signalling slack, the firm can carry it while its results are still uncertain after only one year.

The premium sharing snack line is a low-risk extension of the firm's salami expertise and has its own web page, so without evidence of falling below aspiration levels management would keep it rather than redirect its resources.
